title: the three non units are exactly the unreachable — a machine-checked theorem of the ℤ/9 vortex deposit
description:
the three non units are exactly the unreachable, declared in src/proof/index.lean and accepted by the Lean 4 kernel, sorry-free and axiom-free, closing by by decide.

Statement (Lean):

((List.range 9).filter (fun d => ! isUnit d)) = [0, 3, 6] ∧ ((List.range 9).filter (fun d => ! isUnit d)).all (fun d => ! span.contains d) ∧ ((List.range 9).filter isUnit).length + ((List.range 9).filter (fun d => ! isUnit d)).length = 9

\{\, d \in \{0,\dots,8\} \mid \lnot \mathrm{isUnit}\mathopen{}\left(d\right) \,\} = [0,\,3,\,6] \land \forall d \in \{\, d \in \{0,\dots,8\} \mid \lnot \mathrm{isUnit}\mathopen{}\left(d\right) \,\},\; \lnot d \in \mathrm{span} \land \left|\{\, x \in \{0,\dots,8\} \mid \mathrm{isUnit}\mathopen{}\left(x\right) \,\}\right| + \left|\{\, d \in \{0,\dots,8\} \mid \lnot \mathrm{isUnit}\mathopen{}\left(d\right) \,\}\right| = 9
